City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 19, 2019 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Proclamation declaring June as Pride Month in the City of Encinitas.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the May 22, 2019 Special Meeting and the May 22, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-06-19 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-06-19 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Resolution accepting a report for state-mandated annual fire inspections in compliance with SB 1205. Contact Person: Fire Marshal Pupping
Adopt Resolution No. 2019-40 accepting a report on the status of all state-mandated annual fire inspections in the City of Encinitas in conjunction with SB 1205 and California Health and Safety Code Section 13146.4.
2019-06-19 Item 08C Resolution 2019-40 Accepting a Report for State-Mandated Annual Fire Inspections in Compliance with SB 1205
8D.
Sheriff’s Department 960 Hour Rehire Program. Contact Person: City Planner Sapa’u
Extend the Sheriff’s Department 960 Hour Rehire Program and utilize funds for overtime for a regular deputy to support the program if retired deputies are not provided.
2019-06-19 Item 08D Sheriff 960 program
8E.
Approval of Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2019/20 Pension Funding Policy, Operating and Capital Budgets. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Adopt Resolution No. 2019-33 Approving the Fiscal Year 2019/20 CalPERS Pension Funding Policy, Operating and Capital Improvement Budgets of the Encina Wastewater Authority.
2019-06-19 Item 08E Encina Wastewater Authority Budget Approval
8F.
Reauthorization of the Opening Doors Program. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Review the third year (FY 2018-19) results of the Opening Doors Program; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding with the Community Resource Center (CRC) for implementation of the fourth year of the Opening Doors Program in the City of Encinitas in substantial form, as attached, subject to the review and approval of the City Attorney.
2019-06-19 Item 08F Opening Doors Fourth Year
8G.
Introduction of Ordinance 2019-07 establishing a new speed limit of 20 miles per hour on Neptune Avenue. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Introduce Ordinance 2019-07 entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limits on Neptune Avenue.”
2019-06-19 Item 08G Neptune Speed Limit
8H.
Consideration of a request (by the property owner) for the City Council to initiate a lot merger between two existing legal lots into one legal lot located within the Cardiff by-the-Sea Specific Plan area. CASE NUMBER: 17-106 COC; APPLICANT: Tom and Amy Vorhees; LOCATION: 2137 Newcastle Avenue (APN: 261-061-08). Contact Person: Associate Planner Dichoso
Direct staff to initiate the merger of Lots 39 and 40 of Map No. 1298, in accordance with Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 24.76 (Lot Merger).
2019-06-19 Item 08H Vorhees SFR Lot Merger
8I.
Adoption Resolution No. 2019-48 authorizing the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Encinitas and Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Local 221; adopt Resolution No. 2019-49 approving salary and benefit changes for unrepresented employees and adopt Resolution No. 2019-50 approving position title and pay ranges and adopt Resolution No. 2019-51 amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 and Fiscal Year 2020-21 Operating Budget to include the costs of the changes. Contact Person: Director of Human Resources Bokosky
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-48 authorizing the City Manager or designee(s) to execute a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and Service Employees International Union Local 221; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-49, approving salary and benefit changes for unrepresented employees; 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-50, approving the Fiscal Year 2019-20 and Fiscal Year 2020-21 Position Title and Pay Range Schedule for all City of Encinitas employees; and 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-51 amending the adopted Fiscal Year 2019-20 and Fiscal Year 2020-21 Operating Budget to include the approved changes.
2019-06-19 Item 08I Approval of SEIU MOU
8J.
Adoption of Resolution No. 2019-53 approving salary and benefit changes for Fire Chief Officers and rescinding Resolution No. 2017-87 and adopt Resolution No. 2019-54 amending the adopted Fiscal Year 2019-20 Operating Budget to include the costs of the changes. Contact Person: Director of Human Resources Bokosky
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-53 Implementing the Terms and Conditions of Employment for Fire Chief Officers and Rescinding Resolution 2017-87; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-54 amending the adopted Fiscal Year 2019-20 and Fiscal Year 2020-21 operating budget to include the approved changes.
2019-06-19 Item 08J Fire Chief Officers Compensation Resolution
8K.
Amendment No. 3 to City Manager’s Employment Agreement. Contact Person: Council Subcommittee Members Mayor Blakespear and Council Member Hinze
1) Approve Amendment No. 3 to the City Manager’s Employment Agreement to include an increase in the annual base compensation by two percent (2%), $5,000.86 for a total of $255,043.86 and an additional forty (40) hours of vacation leave annually, effective June 1, 2019; and 2) Approve Resolution No. 2019-57, a budget adjustment of $5,001 to the City Manager department budget for Fiscal Year 2019-20.
2019-06-19 Item 08K City Manager Contract Amendment
8L.
As-Needed Real Property Appraisal Services. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Kellar
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute as-needed contracts (in substantial form as Attachment 1) for real property appraisal services for a grand total not to exceed $300,000 with: a) Hendrickson Appraisal Company, Inc. - total not to exceed $150,000; and b) Bender Rosenthal Inc. - total not to exceed $150,000.
2019-06-19 Item 08L As Needed Appraisal Services
8M.
City Council Resolution No. 2019-47 approving: (1) The ratification of a budget transfer of $18,000 to provide funding to the current Civic Solutions, Inc. contract to facilitate the payment for services approved by City Council on April 24, 2019 for services through June 30, 2019; and (2) An amendment to the Civic Solutions, Inc. contract agreement for additional Planner support for Fiscal Years 2019- 2020 & 2020-2021. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Noel
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-47, approving the ratification of a budget transfer of $18,000; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to amend the current contract agreement with Civic Solutions, Inc. in substantial form as attached, in consultation with the City Attorney, adding the Fiscal Years 2019-2020 & 2020-2021 Two-Year Operating budget allocation of $330,000 to the contract, for a total not-to exceed amount of $576,000. This is included in the Two-Year budget.
2019-06-19 Item 08M Civic Solutions Budget Adjustment
8N.
Leucadia Watershed Master Plan budget appropriation. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract, amendments, and time extensions with the selected consultant in an amount not to exceed $583,000 for preparation of the Leucadia Watershed Master Plan; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-52 entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget.
2019-06-19 Item 08N Leucadia Watershed Report
8O.
Fiscal Year 2018-19 Third Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Third Quarter Budget Status Report; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-55 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget.”
2019-06-19 Item 08O Third Quarter Budget Review and Amendments
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10A.
Public Hearing to consider a timely-filed appeal of the Planning Commission’s approval of the Miano Duplex Addition for the renovation of an existing duplex with a second-floor addition, and use of a temporary construction trailer. CASE NUMBER: 18-169 DR/CDP; APPLICANT: Donna Miano; APPELLANT: Ken and Kristine Price; LOCATION: 404 & 406 Fourth Street (APN 258-074-01). Contact Person: Associate Planner Dichoso
Deny the appeal, uphold the approval of the Planning Commission decision and adopt the attached draft City Council Resolution No. 2019-46.

10B.
City of Encinitas Community Grant Program Application Requests for FY 2019-20. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
Approve the evaluation panel’s recommended funding allocations and make any desired additional allocations to the grant applicants.
2019-06-19 Item 10B City of Encinitas Community Grant Program Application Requests for FY 2019-20
10C.
Public Hearing and Introduction of Ordinance 2019-06, an Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adding Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.28 – Leaf Blower Ordinance. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1) Open the Public Hearing; and 2) Introduce Ordinance 2019-06, An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Adding Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.28 – Leaf Blower Ordinance.
2019-06-19 Item 10C Leaf Blower Ordinance
10D.
Public Hearing and Consideration of Resolution 2019-37 Approving Solid Waste Collection Rates. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Conduct a Public Hearing on solid waste collection service rate increase; and 2) If the final tabulation of written protest votes does not represent a majority of property owners/customers, adopt Resolution 2019-37 approving solid waste collection rates.
2019-06-19 Item 10D EDCO Rates

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JULY 10, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
